evidence.source_assertion: The exact pathway lists five reactions.
Four predecessor relationships connect the five events.
MtnA and Ald2 give DHAP and methylthioacetaldehyde downstream of MTA phosphorolysis.
Mar is required for MT-EtOH conversion and sulfur salvage.
Rru_A0774 captures methanethiol with O-acetylhomoserine to regenerate methionine.

reviewer_rationale: All five native events and four material transfers are present. The upstream MtnP phosphorolysis is correctly outside this exact pathway; no physical substrate channel is inferred.
current_text: This exact five-event MetaCyc pathway, also called the DHAP–ethylene shunt, starts with S-methyl-5-thio-α-D-ribose 1-phosphate (MTR1P). MtnA makes the corresponding ribulose phosphate; Ald2 cleaves it to dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DHAP) and (methylsulfanyl)acetaldehyde. Reduction gives 2-methylthioethanol (MT-EtOH), which methylthio-alkane reductase (Mar) converts to ethylene and methanethiol. O-acetylhomoserine sulfhydrylase captures methanethiol as methionine. Upstream MTA phosphorolysis supplies MTR1P but lies outside these five events. The graph preserves all 22 native reaction-side occurrences, four intermediate transfers and the complete nested Mar assembly; continuity does not assert physical substrate channeling.

current_text: The Mar equation retains one MT-EtOH, two reduced ferredoxin equivalents and two protons yielding one ethylene, one methanethiol, one water and two oxidized ferredoxin equivalents. Those representations are not asserted to be exact reaction equivalents.
